ai_summary: This corrigendum clarifies Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited's upcoming EGM, detailing the utilization of INR 566 crore from a proposed preferential issue of equity shares and warrants. The capital is overwhelmingly allocated to a strategic pivot into large-scale solar energy manufacturing and infrastructure projects through its subsidiaries, representing a complete business transformation from its former chemicals operations. This aggressive shift into a new, capital-intensive sector, despite significant participation from promoters and KMPs, introduces substantial execution and integration risks.
